speaker: Klemens Kappel
identityBasis: Official debate description plus Copenhagen research profile and Edinburgh visiting lecture biography identify the same Copenhagen philosopher.
biography: Klemens Kappel is a philosopher at the University of Copenhagen whose research examines how social settings shape knowledge, evidence, and disagreement. His work also addresses the role of expertise in democratic decisions, political philosophy, and bioethics.
